Summary: [ADM-01] Kiểm thử tự động API, UI Phân quyền & An toàn Bảo mật Module Admin Management CMS
Description: User Story: As a QA Tester, I want to verify input data validation (BVA/EP), access control authorization, dynamic UI handling, and protection against common web vulnerabilities (XSS, SQL Injection) for admin CMS endpoints (/add_movie.php, /manage_movies.php, /orders.php, /customers.php, /statistics.php). Acceptance Criteria: [AC1] Block unauthorized access to login. [AC2] Validate boundary for year [1900, 2030] & duration [1, 600]. [AC3] SQLi and XSS protection. [AC4] Response time < 1500ms. Definition of Done: design_testcase_adm.csv, admin_collection.json, admin_management_test.js (100% pass), report_run_testcase_adm.csv.

Summary: [MOV-01] Kiểm thử tự động API, Giao diện Lọc danh mục, Tìm kiếm phim & Phát video
Description: User Story: As a QA Tester, I want to validate the Movies & Search feature (/movies.php, /search.php, /watch.php, /index.php) using automated Postman and CodeceptJS test suites to ensure movie catalog filtering, keyword search, video playback, and home page rendering work securely. Acceptance Criteria: [AC1] Filter by genre without Fatal error. [AC2] Secure search against SQL Injection. [AC3] Watch page handles boundary of Movie IDs. [AC4] Home page Netfix branding. [AC5] Response time < 1500ms. Definition of Done: design_testcase_mov.csv, movie_mov_collection.json, movies_search_test.js (100% pass), report_run_testcase_mov.csv.
